title: eBPF XDP socket buffer packet descriptor leak on ring buffer full
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0628: eBPF XDP socket buffer packet descriptor leak on ring buffer full
Repository: `cilium/cilium`
Category: `High-Throughput Network Protocols`
Target File: `bpf/xdp_redirect.c`

#### Problem Description
UMEM frame reference not returned to fill ring when xsk_socket__sendto encounters EBUSY under 40GbE burst.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Requeue unconsumed packet descriptors to completion queue on transmission backpressure.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0628.py -q`
expected_invariant: Requeue unconsumed packet descriptors to completion queue on transmission backpressure.
